items.title: iQIYI Reconstructs Lost 1938 Film Using NadouPro AI Workflow
items.excerpt: An eight-person team used iQIYI's NadouPro platform to reconstruct a 1938 film whose prints, reels and scripts had been lost, the company announced on November 6, 2026. The short, completed in two months, was shortlisted...
items.rationale: Concrete restoration result: an eight-person team rebuilt a lost 1938 film in two months on iQIYI's NadouPro platform. It shows AI applied to film heritage rather than new synthetic content.

dedup.note: Replaces the sponsored Theoretically Media video (OpenArt affiliate). Distinct from the 11-03 iQIYI studio-opening card: this is a finished reconstruction of a lost 1938 film, announced 11-06. Cross-section grep of published_urls.json was not run.
